components.name: kubectl client
components.description: Reads deployment.yaml, resolves context and credentials, discovers the API resource, and sends the apply request

components.name: API server
components.description: Receives the REST request and coordinates the API request pipeline

components.name: Authentication
components.description: Establishes the caller identity from configured credentials or identity integration

components.name: Authorization
components.description: Checks whether the identity may create or patch Deployments in the namespace

components.name: Mutating admission
components.description: Applicable admission plugins or webhooks can default or mutate the object

components.name: API validation
components.description: Checks schema, field types, required values and Kubernetes API invariants

components.name: Validating admission
components.description: Applicable policy plugins or webhooks can reject the object

components.name: Apply field manager
components.description: Calculates client-side patch or server-side apply ownership and conflict checks

components.name: etcd
components.description: Persists accepted desired Deployment state in the control-plane backing store

components.name: Deployment controller
components.description: Observes Deployment changes and creates or updates a ReplicaSet revision

components.name: ReplicaSet controller
components.description: Creates or removes Pod API objects to converge on desired replicas

components.name: Scheduler
components.description: Filters and scores nodes, then binds each unscheduled Pod to an eligible node

components.name: Worker node + kubelet
components.description: Kubelet observes assigned Pods and coordinates local Pod lifecycle

components.name: Container runtime (CRI)
components.description: Creates Pod sandbox, pulls images and starts containers

components.name: CNI plugin
components.description: Configures Pod IP address and network connectivity during sandbox setup

components.name: Pod + probes
components.description: Containers run; startup, liveness and readiness probes report health

components.name: EndpointSlice controller
components.description: Publishes current eligible Pod IP and port endpoints for Services

components.name: EndpointSlices
components.description: Store the ready backend endpoint set for a Service

components.name: Service dataplane
components.description: kube-proxy or eBPF dataplane routes Service traffic to eligible Pod endpoints

operational_steps: kubectl reads deployment.yaml and parses the Kubernetes object
kubectl resolves kubeconfig context, namespace, credentials and API resource mapping
kubectl sends the create or patch request to the API server
API server receives the request and establishes the request pipeline
Authorization checks the requested verb and resource scope
Mutating admission applies applicable defaults or mutations
API validation checks schema and resource invariants
Validating admission evaluates applicable policy and can reject the request
Apply logic calculates patch / field ownership and detects conflicts
etcd persists the accepted desired Deployment state
Deployment controller observes the change and creates or updates a ReplicaSet
ReplicaSet controller creates the required Pod API objects
Scheduler selects eligible worker nodes and binds unscheduled Pods
Worker kubelet observes assigned Pods and prepares volumes
CRI runtime creates Pod sandbox and containers; CNI configures Pod networking
Startup, liveness and readiness probes operate according to their configuration
EndpointSlice controller updates the Service's eligible backend endpoint set
Service dataplane routes client traffic to ready Pod endpoints
failure_checkpoint: Forbidden apply, admission rejection or unschedulable Pods
recovery_path: Check auth can-i, server dry-run and Pod events; fix permissions, policy or scheduling capacity.
